calls.statement:
WITH q1_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.product_key,
    f.quantity,
    p.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
    AND f.sale_date >= '2025-04-28'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2025-07-27'
),
returns_of_q1_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    q.sales_line_id,
    q.product_key,
    q.quantity as quantity_sold,
    COALESCE(r.quantity_returned, 0) as quantity_returned,
    q.subcategory
  FROM q1_sales q
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON q.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
)
SELECT 
  subcategory,
  SUM(quantity_sold) as units_sold,
  SUM(quantity_returned) as units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(quantity_returned) / SUM(quantity_sold), 2) as return_rate_pct
FROM returns_of_q1_sales
GROUP BY subcategory
ORDER BY subcategory

-- Check for any Q1 sales with returns recorded after the period to understand if there's a lag
WITH q1_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.sale_date,
    p.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
    AND f.sale_date >= '2025-04-28'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2025-07-27'
)
SELECT 
  MIN(q.sale_date) as earliest_q1_sale,
  MAX(q.sale_date) as latest_q1_sale,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) as returns_with_dates,
  MAX(r.return_date) as latest_return_date
FROM q1_sales q
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON q.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id

-- Check for any Garden sales with null product_key or other data quality issues
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_q1_garden_sales,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN product_key IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_product_key_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-04-28'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2025-07-27'
  AND f.product_key IN (
    SELECT product_key FROM dim_product WHERE category = 'Garden' AND is_current = true
  )

-- Verify total units match our calculation
WITH q1_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.product_key,
    f.quantity,
    p.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
    AND f.sale_date >= '2025-04-28'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2025-07-27'
)
SELECT 
  SUM(quantity) as total_units_sold,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) as total_lines
FROM q1_sales

WITH q1_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.product_key,
    f.quantity,
    p.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
    AND f.sale_date >= '2025-04-28'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2025-07-27'
),
returns_of_q1_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    q.sales_line_id,
    q.product_key,
    q.quantity as quantity_sold,
    COALESCE(r.quantity_returned, 0) as quantity_returned,
    q.subcategory
  FROM q1_sales q
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON q.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
)
SELECT 
  subcategory,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(quantity_returned) / SUM(quantity_sold), 2) as return_rate_pct
FROM returns_of_q1_sales
GROUP BY subcategory
ORDER BY subcategory
